messages:
alex: OK team — putting a lightweight decision canvas here. Customer asks keep coming for: per-route cost breakdown, trace hook sampling, and clearer error grouping. I sketched three scope options for the console observability slice. Need quick thumbs on which we push for the Q2 launch.

mira: sharing the sketch now: 1) Minimal: dashboards + cost per-route (no span-level tracing), 2) Standard: dashboards + sampling hooks + error grouping, 3) Premium: everything + per-tenant cost and full trace links.

sam: oof. customers asking for span links (to link UI -> tracing) are large-enterprise only, but they block integrations. My priority: Standard. hits most customers without doubling cost. :+1:

jamie: Standard makes sense. We should define launch criteria though: dashboards live, cost breakdown accurate within 5%, trace hooks exposed to ops team, error grouping finds >80% of noise patterns.

alex: agreed. also we need guardrails for telemetry sampling to keep token costs sane. propose default sampling 1% but allow per-customer override for Dedicated. thoughts?

mira: 1% default seems safe. maybe add a guided policy in UI: show estimated token delta before enabling. small copy: "Estimated monthly token increase: ~X".

sam: +1. also need a quick implement plan for trace hooks: a small server-side hook that forwards span IDs for requests flagged by the batcher. pseudocode: ```
// attach if sampling true
headers['x-span-id'] = currentSpan.id
store(kvKey, prefixKV)
```

jamie: for cost breakdown: we must tie tokens to route + model variant. That means runtime needs to emit per-request meta: {route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out}. We can fake it in the console for launch with best-effort attribution. later we migrate to realtime per-tenant billing hooks.

alex: good call. risks: attribution error margin, increased telemetry volume, and UX complexity. mitigation: 1) show confidence band on cost numbers, 2) cap retention of raw per-request logs to 7d, 3) default sampling.

mira: launch checklist candidate items: - dashboards end-to-end - cost per-route widget + confidence band - trace hook API + small SDK docs - error grouping + lookback 24h - canary with 5 customers - runbook for ops 

sam: canary plan: 5 customers (2 PLG, 2 enterprise, 1 Dedicated) for 2 weeks. Monitor: token delta, dashboard queries latency, and false-positive error groups. If token delta > +30% rollback sampling.

alex: agreed. owner matrix: Product: alex, Eng-runtime: sam, Eng-platform: mira, Docs: jamie, Oncall: @deploy-bot for automated canary alerts.

jamie: UI notes: keep initial cost widget simple: bar per-route + explanatory tooltip. Avoid per-span UI in v1. Link out to traces via span ID if available.

mira: implementation spikes: 1) telemetry schema change (2 days), 2) trace hook SDK + runtime flag (3 days), 3) dashboard + cost aggregation job (4 days), 4) error grouping heuristics + tests (3 days). total ~12 dev days across teams.

sam: dependency: runtime needs to surface model token counts. I can add a lightweight emit in the request path. need to coordinate with infra for retention.

alex: decision time: we're aligning to Standard (dashboards + sampling hooks + error grouping). action: sam spin up telemetry schema PR today, mira create sprint ticket for dashboard widgets, jamie draft copy for UI + docs. can everyone drop thumbs in thread?

mira: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

jamie: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CANARY ALERT SETUP: scheduled canary for 5 customers on 1717200000. Will post rollout status.

alex: thanks all. I'll update the roadmap slice and add launch criteria to the release doc. leaving parking-lot items: per-tenant cost and full-span UI for later.
